review_text: Cafe Demitasse is the perfect spot for those looking for a comfortable, spacious café with great food and excellent service. The place itself is wide and well laid out, making it ideal for both casual dining and group gatherings. You never feel cramped, even during busy hours, which adds to the overall relaxing atmosphere. The food is consistently good—well-prepared, flavorful, and satisfying. Whether you’re there for a quick meal, coffee time, or a full group dining experience, the menu offers reliable choices that everyone can enjoy. What truly stands out is their service. The staff are attentive, polite, and quick to respond, making sure guests feel well taken care of from start to finish. One of Cafe Demitasse’s biggest highlights is their spacious VIP rooms, with options that can comfortably accommodate 12 up to 60 guests. This makes it an excellent venue for birthdays, meetings, family gatherings, and private celebrations where privacy and comfort matter. Overall, Cafe Demitasse delivers a complete experience—wide and welcoming space, good food, dependable service, and flexible VIP room options for small to large groups. A great choice

After a hefty lunch, we stopped by and had some hot beverage. Tried their banoffee pie - not so sweet (pasado sa Tita vibe), cafe mocha, cappuccino. Coffeee were decent, nice interior, excellent service by staff- special mention to JB who was very attentive and elevated the experience for us!

I ordered the iced cappuccino with an extra shot—perfectly strong and smooth! Also had the Nutella & banana crepes and tried the banoffee pie 🍰. Everything was absolutely delicious. Service was quick (only about a 10-minute wait), and the staff were very friendly and helpful. The interior design is modern and cozy, making it a great spot to relax. Highly recommend this local gem in Davao!

I honestly think Café Demitasse is a bit overrated. The food isn’t consistently good—only a handful of dishes are truly enjoyable, while most tend to be overly creamy and heavy. For the price point, it doesn’t really feel worth it. The drinks are also underwhelming. What I do like, however, is the nostalgic touch of serving coffee with classic biscuit bites topped with dry icing, which brings back those 90s vibes. If there’s something commendable about this place, it would be their cakes, which are quite good, and the genuinely warm service from their staff.

Ok....so if you are looking for large portions this is not for you...but if you are wanting excellent quality and delicious food then definitely eat here! I ordered a lot of food because I have been using Food Panda. Well Food Panda "Sucks"!!! I ordered food through them...never arrived yet they say delivered....several other problems. So I felt I needed to order enough this time so I could survive the day...Lol. Anyway back to Cafe Demitasse....it is obvious to me that the Chief (s) have PASSION about food. I ordered a veggie and cheese omelet. Very delicious and filling. Fresh cheese evenly spread on top....moist but not water logged like others I have tried. Very fresh cucumber and tomato on the side. I chose toast instead of rice. The toast was eh. I would suggest maybe toast with garlic and parmesan cheese. But not a biggie. I ordered a Hawaiian pizza for later...so review later. I got a iced mocha.. yumminess galore! I'm used to a LOT of caffeine so I ordered 2 extra espresso...ok now we're talking! I also ordered a Snickers cake......delish.. Fresh...with fresh peanuts. So yes it can take a while to get your food...but it is NOT fast food...how to McDonalds or Jollibee for that. Salamat for job well done!
